2123091550448074913.en_summary: Last week, Nvidia's CEO Jensen Huang resigned with immediate effect after reports of extramarital relationships, including one with a Chinese spy. CFO Colette Kress is now interim CEO. The stock fell about 4% on the day he stepped down. Strategy and capital allocation get attention, but judgment, ethics, and succession planning matter just as much. Author has no position in $NVDA.
2123091550448074913.zh_summary: 上週，Nvidia 執行長 Jensen Huang 因有關婚外關係（包括與一名中國間諜）的報導而立即辭職。財務長 Colette Kress 現為臨時執行長。股價在他下台當天下跌約 4%。策略和資本配置獲得關注，但判斷力、道德和繼任計劃同樣重要。作者在 $NVDA 無持倉。

ticker_notes.NVDA: Jensen Huang 因婚外關係及與中國間諜傳聞立即辭職，股價當日跌約 4%，Colette Kress 任臨時執行長
